## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()
import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

Fan out sub-agents and have sub-agents tackle each one individually so that the game is utterly perfect. Have a separate sub-agent check each item visually to ensure it looks triple A. That separate sub-agent should be a really harsh critic, and if it doesn't look triple A, keep iterating until it does.

Don't stop until each sub-agent is utterly wowed with the quality when compared with the actual Call of Duty game. It should literally compare them side by side blind and say which one looks better. Do this in ThreeJS. Continue iterating until it's utterly perfect. Fan out sub-agents and ultracode.
# OMG (Oh My GitHub) agent instructions

Do not implement, suggest, report, or propose security issues unless the user explicitly asks for a security review.
Inspect the OpenCode implementation at `/Users/igor/Documents/ChatGPT/opencode` and [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) for related requests.

## Wiki index

- [OpenCode workflow](wiki/opencode.md)
- [Test OpenCode execution](wiki/opencode-v2-experiment.md)
- [Oh My Github App](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/oh-my-github-app.md)
- [Temporary Mac SSH access](wiki/access.md)
- [Testing and verification](wiki/testing.md)
- [OmGithub publishing](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/omgithub.md)


## Main project file

The main project file is [.github/workflows/opencode.yml](.github/workflows/opencode.yml).

Keep the local [game issue E2E skill](.agents/skills/game-issue-e2e/SKILL.md)
aligned with this workflow. Create an issue with `OpenCode` and only user-requested mode labels already attached, to start the native `issues.opened` listener. Wait only for the
initial OpenCode session link during E2E kickoff. Install the listener on the
default branch before requesting execution. Validate author access and freeze
the request inside Actions before starting the reusable execution job.
Set repository variable `OPENCODE_ACCESS=everyone` to accept any issue author
for labeled issues. Keep the App as a setup
helper. Use Actions concurrency to serialize each issue.
Store `branch` in an `omgithub-request:v1` JSON HTML comment to select the
project checkout, result base, and workflow. Let default-branch preparation
dispatch the selected branch. Run preparation and OpenCode in that branch run.

## Shell timing

When writing shell scripts,
always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
interactive shell commands.

## Ideas

Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
`./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
`ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.




## Links in handoffs

When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use
the `codex://threads/<thread-id>` URL format.

When mentioning a commit, append its relative age in hours or days.

## OpenCode GitHub Actions

To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.
Check for a native `issues` run and successful preparation.
The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,
verifies it, runs OpenCode, and cleans up the SSH session afterward.

When monitoring a triggered run, use `gh run watch <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --exit-status` for overall job status.
Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.

Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.

Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.
Wait for that assistant message before requiring the interrupted idle marker.

To connect to an issue's live worker, find its run ID with
`gh run list --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --workflow opencode.yml --status in_progress`,
then run `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>` to discover the host and port and SSH
with `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb` as shown by the helper.

When the user asks to check a live OpenCode workflow, always pull the runner logs
over SSH first, using `scripts/ssh-run-log.sh` or a targeted SSH read from the
same runner. Base the answer on those logs before discussing whether an action
is confirmed; do not lead with a generic inability-to-confirm statement when
live log evidence can be collected.

For real-time inspection from a live temporary SSH session, use the helper:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>
```

The helper discovers the temporary SSH command from the triggering issue or pull
request, then follows the freshest `_diag/pages` log. The runner uploads chunks from
`_diag/blocks` to GitHub. Do not print environment files, tokens, or private keys while
inspecting the runner.

## Mac SSH access

The Mac private key stays at `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`. Its public key is
stored in the repository Actions secret `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY`. The issue
commented by the workflow contains a directly usable command such as:

```sh
ssh -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

The command works only while the corresponding Actions job is running.

## Connecting to a live OpenCode worker

Use the repository helper to discover the worker host and port from the broker
or issue comment. It uses the persistent local key `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub
```

For an interactive shell, reuse the host and port printed by the helper and
use the same key:

```sh
ssh -tt -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
  -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb \
  -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

Do not substitute the generated runner key under `sshworker/outputs/keys/`; it
can produce a misleading `Permission denied (publickey)` result. Temporary
worker SSH access ends when the Actions job and session are cleaned up. Never
print secrets while inspecting a worker.

export function formatPower(value) {
  if (value >= 1e12) return (value / 1e12).toFixed(value >= 1e13 ? 0 : 1) + 'T'
  if (value >= 1e9) return (value / 1e9).toFixed(value >= 1e10 ? 0 : 1) + 'B'
  if (value >= 1e6) return (value / 1e6).toFixed(value >= 1e7 ? 0 : 1) + 'M'
  if (value >= 1e3) return (value / 1e3).toFixed(0) + 'K'
  return String(Math.round(value))
}

export function formatNumber(value) {
  return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-US')
}

export function formatTime(seconds) {
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60)
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

startMusic() {
 this.step=0; this.nextNoteTime=ctx.currentTime+0.1;

import { WORLD, FORMS, TECHNIQUES, ENEMIES, formatPower, formatNumber, formatTime } from './data.js'
import { AudioEngine } from './audio.js'
import { renderTitle, renderGame } from './render.js'
import { playerMethods } from './player.js'
import { enemyMethods } from './enemy.js'
import { combatMethods } from './combat.js'

export const GRAVITY = 2550
export const JUMP_V = 920
export const GROUND = WORLD.ground
export const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t
export const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a)
export const choose = (arr) => arr[(Math.random() * arr.length) | 0]
export const sign = (v) => (v < 0 ? -1 : 1)

export function bodyBox(f) {
  const s = f.scale || 1
  return { x: f.x - 32 * s, y: f.y - 196 * s, w: 64 * s, h: 196 * s }
}

export function overlap(a, b) {
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y
}

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id)

const FORM_ABBR = ['BASE', 'SSJ', 'SS2', 'SS3', 'SSG', 'SSB', 'KK×20', 'UI', 'MUI']

export class Game {
  constructor() {
    this.canvas = $('game')
    this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false })
    this.cw = 0
    this.ch = 0
    this.dpr = 1
    this.audio = new AudioEngine()
    this.keys = new Set()
    this.input = { x: 0, guard: false, charge: false, stickX: 0, stickY: 0, jumpLatch: false }
    this.last = performance.now()
    this.best = Number(localStorage.getItem('dbs_best') || 0)
    this.soundOn = localStorage.getItem('dbs_sound') !== 'off'
    this.helpReturn = 'title'
    this.timers = {}
    this.s = {
      mode: 'title',
      paused: false,
      time: 0,
      titleTime: 0,
      fightTime: 0,
      introTimer: 0,
      finishTimer: 0,
      finish: null,
      player: null,
      enemy: null,
      enemyIndex: 0,
      particles: [],
      rings: [],
      texts: [],
      afterimages: [],
      speedlines: [],
      projectiles: [],
      beams: [],
      hitboxes: [],
      telegraphs: [],
      combo: 0,
      comboTimer: 0,
      maxCombo: 0,
      camera: { x: 800, y: 520, scale: 1, shake: 0, shakeX: 0, shakeY: 0 },
      hitstop: 0,
      slowmo: 0,
      flash: 0,
      flashColor: '#ffffff',
      flashDecay: 4,
      readyNotified: false,
      damageDealt: 0,
      runTime: 0,
      fightDamage: 0,
      fightStartForm: 0,
      retryForm: 0,
      deaths: 0,
      lastResult: null
    }
    this.dom = {}
    this.cacheDom()
    this.resize()
    this.bindEvents()
    this.titleHero = this.makeTitleHero()
    this.updateSoundButton()
    this.updateBestLabel()
  }

  cacheDom() {
    const ids = [
      'hud', 'enemy-stage', 'enemy-power', 'enemy-name', 'enemy-title', 'enemy-hp-fill', 'enemy-hp-ghost',
      'stage-label', 'timer-label', 'form-badge', 'form-abbr', 'form-name', 'player-hp-fill', 'player-hp-ghost',
      'player-hp-text', 'player-ki-fill', 'player-power-fill', 'player-spirit-fill', 'player-power-level',
      'transform-hint', 'combo', 'combo-num', 'combo-timer', 'combo-timer-wrap', 'skillbar', 'toast',
      'enemy-card', 'ec-stage', 'ec-name', 'ec-title', 'ec-quote', 'announce', 'announce-main', 'announce-sub',
      'flash', 'screen-title', 'screen-help', 'screen-pause', 'screen-victory', 'screen-defeat', 'screen-complete',
      'best-stage', 'btn-sound', 'pause-form', 'victory-kicker', 'victory-sub', 'victory-damage', 'victory-combo',
      'victory-time', 'victory-form', 'next-card', 'next-name', 'next-title', 'btn-next', 'defeat-sub',
      'defeat-damage', 'defeat-combo', 'defeat-stage', 'defeat-form', 'complete-damage', 'complete-combo',
      'complete-time', 'complete-form', 'stick-ring', 'stick-knob', 'touch-controls'
    ]
    for (const id of ids) this.dom[id] = $(id)
    this.skillButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.skill'))
  }

  makeTitleHero() {
    return {
      kind: 'player', x: 1110, y: GROUND, facing: 1, scale: 1.16, form: 5, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      state: 'idle', stateT: 0, animT: 0, anim: 'idle', hp: 1000, maxHp: 1000, dead: false,
      grounded: true, blocking: false, hitFlash: 0, koT: 0, invuln: 0
    }
  }

  resize() {
    this.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2)
    this.cw = window.innerWidth
    this.ch = window.innerHeight
    this.canvas.width = Math.floor(this.cw * this.dpr)
    this.canvas.height = Math.floor(this.ch * this.dpr)
    this.canvas.style.width = this.cw + 'px'
    this.canvas.style.height = this.ch + 'px'
  }

  start() {
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.resize())
    this.last = performance.now()
    this.loop = this.loop.bind(this)
    requestAnimationFrame(this.loop)
  }

  loop(now) {
    requestAnimationFrame(this.loop)
    const raw = Math.min((now - this.last) / 1000, 0.05)
    this.last = now
    if (!this.s.paused) {
      if (this.s.hitstop > 0) {
        this.s.hitstop -= raw
        this.updateEffects(raw * 0.2)
      } else {
        let scale = 1
        if (this.s.slowmo > 0) {
          scale = 0.3
          this.s.slowmo -= raw
        }
        this.update(raw * scale)
      }
    }
    this.updateCamera(raw)
    if (this.s.mode === 'title') renderTitle(this)
    else renderGame(this)
    this.updateUI()
  }

  update(dt) {
    const s = this.s
    s.time += dt
    s.titleTime += dt
    if (s.mode === 'title') {
      this.updateEffects(dt)
      return
    }
    if (s.combo > 0) {
      s.comboTimer -= dt
      if (s.comboTimer <= 0) s.combo = 0
    }
    if (s.mode === 'intro') {
      s.introTimer -= dt
      this.updateEffects(dt)
      this.stepFighterPhysics(s.player, dt)
      this.stepFighterPhysics(s.enemy, dt)
      if (s.introTimer <= 0) {
        s.mode = 'fight'
        this.announce('FIGHT!', 'SHOW ME YOUR TRUE POWER', 1.5)
        this.audio.ui()
      }
      return
    }
    if (s.mode === 'fight') {
      this.readInput()
      if (!s.finish) s.fightTime += dt
      s.runTime += dt
      this.updatePlayer(dt)
      this.updateEnemy(dt)
      this.updateCombat(dt)
      this.updateEffects(dt)
      if (s.finishTimer > 0) {
        s.finishTimer -= dt
        if (s.finishTimer <= 0) this.showResult(s.finish)
      }
      return
    }
    this.updateEffects(dt)
  }

  updateEffects(dt) {
    const s = this.s
    for (let i = s.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = s.particles[i]
      p.life -= dt
      if (p.life <= 0) { s.particles.splice(i, 1); continue }
      p.vy += (p.gravity ?? 0) * dt
      p.vx *= Math.pow(p.drag ?? 0.6, dt)
      p.vy *= Math.pow(p.drag ?? 0.6, dt)
      p.x += p.vx * dt
      p.y += p.vy * dt
      if (p.floor && p.y > p.floor) { p.y = p.floor; p.vy *= -0.25; p.vx *= 0.7 }
    }
    for (let i = s.rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const r = s.rings[i]
      r.life -= dt
      r.t += dt
      if (r.life <= 0) s.rings.splice(i, 1)
    }
    for (let i = s.texts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = s.texts[i]
      t.life -= dt
      t.y += t.vy * dt
      t.vy *= Math.pow(0.3, dt)
      if (t.life <= 0) s.texts.splice(i, 1)
    }
    for (let i = s.afterimages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const a = s.afterimages[i]
      a.life -= dt
      if (a.life <= 0) s.afterimages.splice(i, 1)
    }
    for (let i = s.speedlines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const l = s.speedlines[i]
      l.life -= dt
      if (l.life <= 0) s.speedlines.splice(i, 1)
    }
    if (s.flash > 0) s.flash = Math.max(0, s.flash - dt * s.flashDecay)
    const shake = s.camera.shake
    if (shake > 0.05) {
      s.camera.shake *= Math.pow(0.12, dt)
      s.camera.shakeX = rand(-shake, shake)
      s.camera.shakeY = rand(-shake, shake)
    } else {
      s.camera.shake = 0
      s.camera.shakeX = 0
      s.camera.shakeY = 0
    }
    if (s.readyNotified) s.readyNotified = s.player && s.player.power < 99.5 ? false : s.readyNotified
  }

  readInput() {
    const k = this.keys
    const left = k.has('a') || k.has('arrowleft')
    const right = k.has('d') || k.has('arrowright')
    let x = (right ? 1 : 0) - (left ? 1 : 0)
    x += this.input.stickX
    this.input.x = clamp(x, -1, 1)
    this.input.guard = k.has('s') || k.has('arrowdown') || this.input.stickY > 0.45
    this.input.charge = k.has('e') || this.input.chargeTouch
  }

  startGame() {
    this.audio.init()
    this.audio.setEnabled(this.soundOn)
    this.audio.setMusicEnabled(this.soundOn)
    this.audio.ui()
    this.resetRun()
    this.hideScreens()
    this.dom.hud.classList.add('on')
    this.startFight(0)
  }

  resetRun() {
    const s = this.s
    s.player = this.createPlayer()
    s.enemy = null
    s.enemyIndex = 0
    s.particles.length = 0
    s.rings.length = 0
    s.texts.length = 0
    s.afterimages.length = 0
    s.speedlines.length = 0
    s.projectiles.length = 0
    s.beams.length = 0
    s.hitboxes.length = 0
    s.telegraphs.length = 0
    s.combo = 0
    s.comboTimer = 0
    s.maxCombo = 0
    s.damageDealt = 0
    s.runTime = 0
    s.deaths = 0
    s.finish = null
    s.finishTimer = 0
    s.slowmo = 0
    s.paused = false
    s.mode = 'title'
  }

  createPlayer() {
    return {
      kind: 'player', x: 550, y: GROUND, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 1, scale: 1.02,
      form: 0, hp: 1000, maxHp: 1000, ki: 100, maxKi: 100, power: 30, spirit: 30,
      state: 'idle', stateT: 0, anim: 'idle', animT: 0, hitstun: 0, invuln: 0,
      blocking: false, dead: false, grounded: true, jumps: 0, dashT: 0, dashCd: 0,
      attackT: 0, attackDuration: 0, attackHitAt: 0, attackHit: false, attackKind: 'light',
      chain: 0, castT: 0, beamHold: 0, beamT: 0, skillId: null, skillT: 0, skillDuration: 0,
      skillDone: false, cooldowns: [0, 0, 0, 0], critWindow: 0, dodgeCd: 0, koT: 0,
      hitFlash: 0, guardFlash: 0, formFx: 0, chargeT: 0, afterimageCd: 0, spiritCharge: 0,
      landDust: 0, lastBeamRatio: 0
    }
  }

  createEnemy(def, index) {
    return {
      kind: 'enemy', def, name: def.name, title: def.title, x: 1060, y: GROUND, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      facing: -1, scale: def.scale || 1, hp: def.hp, maxHp: def.hp, damage: def.damage, speed: def.speed,
      state: 'idle', stateT: 0, anim: 'idle', animT: 0, hitstun: 0, invuln: 0, blocking: false,
      dead: false, grounded: true, koT: 0, hitFlash: 0, guardFlash: 0, formFx: 0, afterimageCd: 0,
      attackT: 0, attackDuration: 0, attackHitAt: 0, attackHit: false, attackKind: 'light',
      special: null, specialT: 0, specialFired: false, specialCd: 2.6 + index * 0.3,
      attackCd: 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.7, kiCd: 1.6 + Math.random(), guardCd: 1.6,
      think: 0.4, attackName: null, enraged: false, aggression: 0.48 + index * 0.06,
      auraPulse: Math.random() * 6, lastSpecial: null, aiDir: 0, recoil: 0
    }
  }

  startFight(index, retry = false) {
    const s = this.s
    const def = ENEMIES[index]
    s.enemyIndex = index
    if (!s.player) s.player = this.createPlayer()
    const p = s.player
    if (retry) p.form = s.fightStartForm
    const ratio = p.maxHp ? p.hp / p.maxHp : 1
    p.maxHp = 1000 + p.form * 55
    if (index === 0 && !retry) p.hp = p.maxHp
    else if (retry) p.hp = p.maxHp
    else p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, Math.max(p.hp, p.maxHp * ratio) + p.maxHp * 0.44)
    p.ki = p.maxKi
    p.spirit = Math.max(24, p.spirit)
    p.power = index === 0 ? 35 : Math.min(100, Math.max(28, p.power))
    p.x = 545
    p.y = GROUND
    p.vx = 0
    p.vy = 0
    p.facing = 1
    p.dead = false
    p.hitstun = 0
    p.invuln = 1.2
    p.blocking = false
    p.state = 'idle'
    p.anim = 'idle'
    p.animT = 0
    p.attackT = 0
    p.beamHold = 0
    p.beamT = 0
    p.dashT = 0
    p.dashCd = 0
    p.castT = 0
    p.skillId = null
    p.critWindow = 0
    p.koT = 0
    p.formFx = 0
    p.cooldowns = [0, 0, 0, 0]
    s.enemy = this.createEnemy(def, index)
    s.fightStartForm = p.form
    s.retryForm = p.form
    s.fightTime = 0
    s.fightDamage = 0
    s.combo = 0
    s.comboTimer = 0
    s.readyNotified = false
    s.finish = null
    s.finishTimer = 0
    s.slowmo = 0
    s.projectiles.length = 0
    s.beams.length = 0
    s.hitboxes.length = 0
    s.telegraphs.length = 0
    s.afterimages.length = 0
    s.mode = 'intro'
    s.introTimer = 2.65
    s.paused = false
    this.hideScreens()
    this.dom.hud.classList.add('on')
    this.audio.setForm(p.form)
    this.setFighterUI()
    this.showEnemyCard(def, index)
    if (index === 0 && !retry) {
      this.toast('HOLD  E  TO CHARGE · PRESS  Q  TO TRANSFORM', 4.3)
    }
  }

  setFighterUI() {
    const s = this.s
    if (!s.enemy) return
    const def = s.enemy.def
    this.dom['enemy-name'].textContent = def.name
    this.dom['enemy-title'].textContent = def.title
    this.dom['enemy-stage'].textContent = `STAGE ${s.enemyIndex + 1} · ${def.stage}`
    this.dom['enemy-power'].textContent = `POWER ${formatPower(def.powerLevel)}`
    this.dom['stage-label'].textContent = `STAGE ${s.enemyIndex + 1} / ${ENEMIES.length}`
    const f = FORMS[s.player.form]
    this.dom['form-name'].textContent = f.name
    this.dom['form-abbr'].textContent = FORM_ABBR[s.player.form]
    this.dom['form-badge'].style.setProperty('--form-color', f.aura2)
  }

  activeForm() {
    return FORMS[this.s.player?.form || 0]
  }

  canAct(p) {
    if (!p || p.dead || p.hitstun > 0 || p.state === 'ko' || p.state === 'hurt') return false
    return !['attack', 'dash', 'beam', 'skill', 'transform', 'cast'].includes(p.state)
  }

  canTransform() {
    const p = this.s.player
    return p && !p.dead && p.hitstun <= 0 && !['ko', 'hurt', 'beam', 'skill', 'transform'].includes(p.state)
  }

  playerTransform() {
    const p = this.s.player
    if (!p || this.s.mode !== 'fight') return
    if (!this.canTransform()) return
    if (p.form >= FORMS.length - 1) {
      this.toast('MASTERED ULTRA INSTINCT IS THE LIMIT', 2.2)
      return
    }
    if (p.power < 99.5) {
      this.toast(`POWER ${Math.round(p.power)}% — HOLD ${this.isTouch() ? 'POWER' : 'E'} TO CHARGE`, 2.2)
      return
    }
    this.setForm(p.form + 1)
  }

  setForm(index) {
    const s = this.s
    const p = s.player
    const oldMax = p.maxHp
    const ratio = clamp(p.hp / oldMax, 0, 1)
    const form = FORMS[index]
    p.form = index
    p.maxHp = 1000 + index * 55
    p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.maxHp * Math.max(ratio, 0.5) + p.maxHp * 0.18)
    p.power = 0
    p.ki = Math.min(p.maxKi, p.ki + 42)
    p.invuln = Math.max(p.invuln, 1.05)
    p.state = 'transform'
    p.stateT = 0
    p.anim = 'transform'
    p.animT = 0
    p.formFx = 1.5
    p.blocking = false
    s.readyNotified = false
    this.audio.transform(index)
    this.audio.setForm(index)
    this.flash(form.aura2, 0.82, 3.2)
    this.shake(28)
    this.ring(p.x, p.y - 105, { max: 210, life: 0.8, color: form.aura2, width: 7 })
    this.ring(p.x, p.y - 105, { max: 120, life: 0.5, color: '#ffffff', width: 3 })
    this.burst(p.x, p.y - 110, 48, { colors: [form.aura, form.aura2, '#ffffff'], speed: 520, size: 5, life: 0.9, gravity: -20 })
    this.burst(p.x, p.y - 10, 28, { colors: [form.aura, '#ffe9a8'], speed: 260, size: 4, life: 0.7, gravity: -60 })
    this.announce(form.name, form.tag, 2.3)
    this.setFighterUI()
    const e = s.enemy
    if (e && !e.dead && Math.abs(e.x - p.x) < 400) {
      e.state = 'hurt'
      e.hitstun = Math.max(e.hitstun, 0.7)
      e.vx = sign(e.x - p.x) * 290
      e.vy -= 120
      e.attackName = null
      e.special = null
      this.textPop(e.x, e.y - 205, 'BLASTED BACK', '#ffe98a', 16)
      this.burst(e.x, e.y - 100, 20, { colors: [form.aura2, '#ffffff'], speed: 350, size: 4, life: 0.6 })
    }
  }

  updateUI() {
    const s = this.s
    if (s.mode === 'title' || !s.player || !s.enemy) return
    const p = s.player
    const e = s.enemy
    const form = FORMS[p.form]
    const hpPct = clamp(p.hp / p.maxHp, 0, 1) * 100
    const kiPct = clamp(p.ki / p.maxKi, 0, 1) * 100
    const powerPct = clamp(p.power / 100, 0, 1) * 100
    const spiritPct = clamp(p.spirit / 100, 0, 1) * 100
    const ehpPct = clamp(e.hp / e.maxHp, 0, 1) * 100
    this.setBar('player-hp-fill', hpPct)
    this.setBar('player-hp-ghost', hpPct)
    this.setBar('player-ki-fill', kiPct)
    this.setBar('player-power-fill', powerPct)
    this.setBar('player-spirit-fill', spiritPct)
    this.setBar('enemy-hp-fill', ehpPct)
    this.setBar('enemy-hp-ghost', ehpPct)
    const hpBar = this.dom['player-hp-fill'].parentElement
    hpBar.classList.toggle('low', hpPct < 28)
    const powerBar = this.dom['player-power-fill'].parentElement
    powerBar.classList.toggle('ready', p.power >= 99.5 && p.form < FORMS.length - 1)
    if (this._hpText !== Math.ceil(p.hp)) {
      this._hpText = Math.ceil(p.hp)
      this.dom['player-hp-text'].textContent = Math.ceil(p.hp)
    }
    const pl = formatPower(form.powerLevel * (1 + p.power / 260))
    if (this._pl !== pl) {
      this._pl = pl
      this.dom['player-power-level'].textContent = pl
    }
    this.dom['form-name'].textContent = form.name
    this.dom['form-abbr'].textContent = FORM_ABBR[p.form]
    this.dom['form-badge'].style.setProperty('--form-color', form.aura2)
    this.dom['timer-label'].textContent = formatTime(s.fightTime)
    let hint
    if (p.form >= FORMS.length - 1) hint = 'MAXIMUM FORM · ULTRA INSTINCT MASTERED'
    else if (p.power >= 99.5) hint = `POWER FULL · ${this.isTouch() ? 'TAP POWER' : 'PRESS Q'} TO ASCEND`
    else hint = this.isTouch() ? 'HOLD POWER · TAP WHEN FULL TO ASCEND' : 'HOLD E TO CHARGE · Q TO ASCEND'
    if (this._hint !== hint) {
      this._hint = hint
      this.dom['transform-hint'].textContent = hint
    }
    this.dom.combo.classList.toggle('on', s.combo > 1)
    this.dom['combo-timer-wrap'].classList.toggle('on', s.combo > 1)
    if (this._combo !== s.combo) {
      this._combo = s.combo
      this.dom['combo-num'].textContent = s.combo
      this.dom['combo-timer'].style.width = '100%'
    }
    if (s.combo > 0) this.dom['combo-timer'].style.width = `${clamp(s.comboTimer / 2.3, 0, 1) * 100}%`
    for (let i = 0; i < this.skillButtons.length; i++) {
      const btn = this.skillButtons[i]
      const tech = TECHNIQUES[i]
      const locked = p.form < tech.minForm
      const cd = p.cooldowns[i]
      btn.classList.toggle('locked', locked)
      const ready = !locked && cd <= 0 && p.ki >= tech.cost && (!tech.spirit || p.spirit >= tech.spirit)
      btn.classList.toggle('ready', ready)
      btn.classList.toggle('pulse', !locked && tech.spirit && p.spirit >= 100 && cd <= 0)
      const cdEl = btn.querySelector('.skill-cd')
      if (cdEl) cdEl.style.setProperty('--cd', `${clamp(cd / tech.cooldown, 0, 1) * 100}%`)
    }
    const touchPower = document.querySelector('.tact[data-act="power"]')
    if (touchPower) {
      touchPower.classList.toggle('full', p.power >= 99.5 && p.form < FORMS.length - 1)
      touchPower.textContent = p.power >= 99.5 && p.form < FORMS.length - 1 ? 'ASCEND' : 'POWER'
    }
  }

  setBar(id, pct) {
    const el = this.dom[id]
    if (!el) return
    const key = '_bar_' + id
    if (this[key] !== pct) {
      this[key] = pct
      el.style.width = pct.toFixed(2) + '%'
    }
  }

  isTouch() {
    return document.body.classList.contains('touch')
  }

  announce(main, sub = '', duration = 2) {
    const el = this.dom.announce
    this.dom['announce-main'].textContent = main
    this.dom['announce-sub'].textContent = sub
    el.classList.remove('show')
    void el.offsetWidth
    el.style.animationDuration = duration + 's'
    el.classList.add('show')
  }

  toast(text, duration = 2.5) {
    const el = this.dom.toast
    el.textContent = text
    el.classList.remove('show')
    void el.offsetWidth
    el.classList.add('show')
    clearTimeout(this.timers.toast)
    this.timers.toast = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), duration * 1000)
  }

  flash(color, strength = 0.6, decay = 4) {
    this.s.flashColor = color
    this.s.flash = Math.max(this.s.flash, strength)
    this.s.flashDecay = decay
  }

  showEnemyCard(def, index) {
    const el = this.dom['enemy-card']
    this.dom['ec-stage'].textContent = `STAGE ${index + 1} OF ${ENEMIES.length} · ${def.stage}`
    this.dom['ec-name'].textContent = def.name
    this.dom['ec-title'].textContent = def.title
    this.dom['ec-quote'].textContent = def.quote
    el.classList.remove('hidden', 'show')
    void el.offsetWidth
    el.classList.add('show')
    clearTimeout(this.timers.enemyCard)
    this.timers.enemyCard = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 3100)
  }

  hideScreens() {
    for (const id of ['screen-title', 'screen-help', 'screen-pause', 'screen-victory', 'screen-defeat', 'screen-complete']) {
      const el = this.dom[id]
      if (el) el.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  showOnly(id) {
    this.hideScreens()
    const el = this.dom[id]
    if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  pause() {
    if (this.s.mode !== 'fight' || this.s.paused) return
    this.s.paused = true
    this.dom['pause-form'].textContent = FORMS[this.s.player.form].name
    this.showOnly('screen-pause')
    this.audio.ui()
  }

  resume() {
    if (!this.s.paused) return
    this.s.paused = false
    this.hideScreens()
    this.dom.hud.classList.add('on')
    this.audio.ui()
  }

  togglePause() {
    if (this.s.mode !== 'fight') return
    if (this.s.paused) this.resume()
    else this.pause()
  }

  quitToTitle() {
    const s = this.s
    s.paused = false
    s.mode = 'title'
    s.player = null
    s.enemy = null
    s.finish = null
    s.projectiles.length = 0
    s.beams.length = 0
    s.hitboxes.length = 0
    s.telegraphs.length = 0
    s.afterimages.length = 0
    this.dom.hud.classList.remove('on')
    this.showOnly('screen-title')
    this.updateBestLabel()
    this.audio.ui()
  }

  openHelp(from) {
    this.helpReturn = from
    if (from === 'title') {
      this.showOnly('screen-help')
    } else {
      this.showOnly('screen-help')
    }
    this.audio.ui()
  }

  closeHelp() {
    if (this.helpReturn === 'pause') {
      this.showOnly('screen-pause')
    } else {
      this.showOnly('screen-title')
    }
    this.audio.ui()
  }

  updateBestLabel() {
    const el = this.dom['best-stage']
    if (!el) return
    if (this.best >= ENEMIES.length) el.textContent = 'BEST: MULTIVERSE CHAMPION'
    else if (this.best > 0) el.textContent = `BEST: STAGE ${this.best + 1}`
    else el.textContent = 'BEST: NO RUN YET'
  }

  recordBest(value) {
    if (value > this.best) {
      this.best = Math.min(value, ENEMIES.length)
      localStorage.setItem('dbs_best', String(this.best))
      this.updateBestLabel()
    }
  }

  updateSoundButton() {
    if (!this.dom['btn-sound']) return
    this.dom['btn-sound'].textContent = this.soundOn ? 'SOUND ON' : 'SOUND OFF'
  }

  toggleSound() {
    this.soundOn = !this.soundOn
    localStorage.setItem('dbs_sound', this.soundOn ? 'on' : 'off')
    this.audio.setEnabled(this.soundOn)
    this.audio.setMusicEnabled(this.soundOn)
    this.audio.init()
    this.updateSoundButton()
    if (this.soundOn) this.audio.ui()
  }

  showResult(kind) {
    const s = this.s
    s.mode = kind
    s.paused = false
    this.dom.hud.classList.remove('on')
    if (kind === 'victory') {
      const last = s.enemyIndex >= ENEMIES.length - 1
      this.recordBest(s.enemyIndex + 1)
      this.dom['victory-kicker'].textContent = last ? 'FINAL STAGE CLEAR' : `STAGE ${s.enemyIndex + 1} CLEAR`
      this.dom['victory-sub'].textContent = `${s.enemy.name} DEFEATED`
      this.dom['victory-damage'].textContent = formatNumber(s.fightDamage)
      this.dom['victory-combo'].textContent = s.maxCombo
      this.dom['victory-time'].textContent = formatTime(s.fightTime)
      this.dom['victory-form'].textContent = FORMS[s.player.form].name
      if (last) {
        this.dom['next-card'].classList.remove('hidden')
        this.dom['next-name'].textContent = 'THE MULTIVERSE IS SAFE'
        this.dom['next-title'].textContent = 'JIREN HAS FALLEN'
        this.dom['btn-next'].textContent = 'FINISH THE STORY'
      } else {
        const next = ENEMIES[s.enemyIndex + 1]
        this.dom['next-card'].classList.remove('hidden')
        this.dom['next-name'].textContent = next.name
        this.dom['next-title'].textContent = next.title
        this.dom['btn-next'].textContent = 'NEXT BATTLE'
      }
      this.showOnly('screen-victory')
      this.audio.victory()
    } else {
      this.recordBest(s.enemyIndex + 1)
      s.deaths++
      this.dom['defeat-sub'].textContent = `${s.enemy.name} STANDS VICTORIOUS`
      this.dom['defeat-damage'].textContent = formatNumber(s.fightDamage)
      this.dom['defeat-combo'].textContent = s.maxCombo
      this.dom['defeat-stage'].textContent = `STAGE ${s.enemyIndex + 1}`
      this.dom['defeat-form'].textContent = FORMS[s.player.form].name
      this.showOnly('screen-defeat')
      this.audio.defeat()
    }
  }

  showComplete() {

import { FORMS, WORLD } from './data.js'
import { GROUND } from './game.js'

const TAU = Math.PI * 2
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))

function pal(f) {
  const isPlayer = f.kind === 'player'
  const look = f.look || f.def?.look || {}
  const v = isPlayer ? 'goku' : (look.body || 'goku')
  const form = FORMS[f.form || 0]
  const base = {
    v,
    skin: look.skin || '#f0c198',
    skin2: look.skin2 || '#c99066',
    gi: look.suit || '#e86a1f',
    gi2: look.suit2 || '#a9410c',
    under: '#173b93',
    pants: look.suit || '#e86a1f',
    pants2: look.suit2 || '#a9410c',
    boot: '#172347',
    boot2: '#0d1428',
    belt: '#f1e6c8',
    wrist: '#1d3b8f',
    hair: v === 'black' ? (look.hair || '#ff70b8') : (isPlayer ? form.hair : (look.hair || '#15161c')),
    hair2: v === 'black' ? '#ffd0e5' : (isPlayer ? form.hair2 : '#3a3b46'),
    accent: look.accent || '#ffcf4a',
    aura: isPlayer ? form.aura : (f.def?.aura || look.accent || '#ffcf4a'),
    aura2: isPlayer ? form.aura2 : (f.def?.aura2 || '#ffffff'),
    eye: isPlayer ? form.eye : (look.eye || '#ff5555'),
    eyeWhite: '#f7f4ec',
    outline: '#070810'
  }
  if (v === 'black') {
    base.gi = '#17151d'
    base.gi2 = '#0a0910'
    base.pants = '#17151d'
    base.pants2 = '#0a0910'
    base.under = '#ff5d9e'
    base.boot = '#0b0a10'
    base.wrist = '#ff5d9e'
    base.belt = '#ffd0e5'
  }
  if (v === 'frieza') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.armor = look.armor
    base.accent = look.accent
    base.eye = look.eye
    base.gi = look.skin
    base.hair = look.hair
  }
  if (v === 'cell') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.accent = look.accent
    base.armor = look.armor
    base.eye = look.eye
  }
  if (v === 'buu') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.gi = look.skin
    base.pants = '#f2ebdc'
    base.pants2 = '#c9bfa9'
    base.boot = '#2b1a34'
    base.eye = look.eye
  }
  if (v === 'broly') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.pants = '#332f28'
    base.pants2 = '#1c1915'
    base.boot = '#181713'
    base.wrist = '#1c1915'
    base.hair = look.hair
    base.hair2 = '#f1ffb8'
    base.eye = look.eye
  }
  if (v === 'beerus') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.pants = '#241b31'
    base.pants2 = '#120c1b'
    base.boot = '#120c1b'
    base.belt = '#e7c35c'
    base.eye = look.eye
    base.accent = look.accent
  }
  if (v === 'jiren') {
    base.skin = look.skin
    base.skin2 = look.skin2
    base.gi = '#20242b'
    base.gi2 = '#101216'
    base.pants = '#20242b'
    base.pants2 = '#101216'
    base.boot = '#0e1013'
    base.wrist = '#0e1013'
    base.eye = look.eye
    base.accent = look.accent
  }
  return base
}

function limb(ctx, x, y, a1, a2, l1, l2, w1, w2, color, outline, capColor, capW) {
  const kx = x + Math.sin(a1) * l1
  const ky = y + Math.cos(a1) * l1
  const fx = kx + Math.sin(a2) * l2
  const fy = ky + Math.cos(a2) * l2
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'
  ctx.strokeStyle = outline
  ctx.lineWidth = w1 + 5
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(kx, ky); ctx.lineTo(fx, fy); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.strokeStyle = color
  ctx.lineWidth = w1
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(kx, ky); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.lineWidth = w2
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(kx, ky); ctx.lineTo(fx, fy); ctx.stroke()
  if (capColor) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = capColor
    ctx.lineWidth = w2 + 1
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(kx, ky)
    ctx.lineTo(kx + Math.sin(a2) * l2 * 0.26, ky + Math.cos(a2) * l2 * 0.26)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  return { kx, ky, fx, fy }
}

function hand(ctx, x, y, r, color, outline) {
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r + 2.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = outline; ctx.fill()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fill()
}

function foot(ctx, x, y, facing, color, dark, outline, big = false) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-7, -4)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-10, 4, -2, 6)
  ctx.lineTo(11 + (big ? 4 : 0), 5)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(16 + (big ? 4 : 0), 2, 12 + (big ? 4 : 0), -3)
  ctx.lineTo(3, -6)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fillStyle = outline
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.translate(1, 0)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-7, -4)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-9, 3, -2, 5)
  ctx.lineTo(10 + (big ? 4 : 0), 4)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(14 + (big ? 4 : 0), 1, 11 + (big ? 4 : 0), -3)
  ctx.lineTo(3, -5)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fillStyle = color
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.fillStyle = dark
  ctx.fillRect(-5, 3, 14 + (big ? 4 : 0), 2)
  ctx.restore()
}

function getPose(f, form, t) {
  const state = f.state || 'idle'
  const anim = f.anim || state
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.4) * 1.6
  const p = {
    bob, lean: 0.02, head: 0, hipY: -86,
    armF: [0.28, 0.5], armB: [-0.28, -0.48],
    legF: [0.16, 0.02], legB: [-0.22, -0.08],
    armScale: 1, legScale: 1, crouch: 0
  }
  const walk = Math.sin(t * 10.5)
  if (state === 'walk') {
    p.lean = 0.07
    p.armF = [0.35 + walk * 0.4, 0.5 + walk * 0.5]
    p.armB = [-0.35 - walk * 0.4, -0.55 - walk * 0.5]
    p.legF = [0.42 * walk + 0.1, 0.42 * walk - 0.08]
    p.legB = [-0.42 * walk - 0.1, -0.42 * walk - 0.08]
    p.bob = Math.abs(walk) * 2
  } else if (state === 'jump') {
    const rising = f.vy < 0
    p.lean = 0.02
    p.armF = [rising ? 1.1 : 0.8, rising ? 0.7 : 0.4]
    p.armB = [rising ? -1.05 : -0.8, rising ? -0.6 : -0.3]
    p.legF = [0.72, 0.95]
    p.legB = [-0.42, 0.8]
    p.bob = -2
  } else if (state === 'dash') {
    p.lean = 0.3
    p.armF = [-0.3, -0.7]
    p.armB = [0.8, 1.2]
    p.legF = [0.85, 1.1]
    p.legB = [-0.65, -0.85]
    p.bob = -3
  } else if (state === 'charge') {
    p.lean = -0.07
    p.armF = [0.8, 1.55]
    p.armB = [-0.8, -1.55]
    p.legF = [0.32, 0.18]
    p.legB = [-0.4, -0.25]
    p.bob = Math.sin(t * 14) * 1.2
  } else if (state === 'guard') {
    p.lean = -0.03
    p.armF = [0.95, 2.4]
    p.armB = [0.45, 2.6]
    p.legF = [0.25, 0.1]
    p.legB = [-0.3, -0.18]
  } else if (state === 'hurt') {
    p.lean = -0.28
    p.head = -0.16
    p.armF = [0.9, 1.5]
    p.armB = [-1.1, -1.5]
    p.legF = [0.35, 0.55]
    p.legB = [-0.5, -0.2]
  } else if (state === 'beam') {
    p.lean = -0.05
    p.armF = [1.47, 1.48]
    p.armB = [1.22, 1.34]
    p.legF = [0.3, 0.2]
    p.legB = [-0.42, -0.28]
  } else if (state === 'beamCharge') {
    p.lean = -0.06
    p.armF = [0.72, 1.3]
    p.armB = [0.48, 1.55]
    p.legF = [0.32, 0.18]
    p.legB = [-0.42, -0.27]
  } else if (state === 'cast') {
    p.lean = 0.07
    p.armF = [1.4, 1.52]
    p.armB = [-0.25, -0.58]
    p.legF = [0.28, 0.16]
    p.legB = [-0.36, -0.2]
  } else if (state === 'attack') {
    const kind = f.attackKind || 'light'
    const prog = clamp((f.attackT || 0) / Math.max(0.01, f.attackDuration || 0.3), 0, 1)
    if (kind === 'heavy') {
      if (prog < 0.42) {
        p.lean = -0.14
        p.armF = [-0.9, -1.25]
        p.armB = [0.55, 0.9]
        p.legF = [0.25, 0.15]
        p.legB = [-0.35, -0.15]
      } else {
        p.lean = 0.2
        p.armF = [1.5, 1.52]
        p.armB = [-0.7, -1.0]
        p.legF = [0.38, 0.22]
        p.legB = [-0.5, -0.32]
      }
    } else if (f.anim === 'kick') {
      p.lean = -0.03
      p.legF = [1.34, 1.42]
      p.legB = [-0.25, -0.12]
      p.armF = [0.55, 0.9]
      p.armB = [-0.7, -1.15]
    } else {
      const wind = prog < 0.2
      p.lean = wind ? -0.05 : 0.13
      p.armF = wind ? [0.55, 0.9] : [1.5, 1.6]
      p.armB = wind ? [-0.8, -1.15] : [-0.5, -0.85]
      p.legF = [0.25, 0.12]
      p.legB = [-0.38, -0.22]
    }
  } else if (state === 'transform') {
    p.lean = -0.02
    p.armF = [2.35, 2.5]
    p.armB = [-2.35, -2.5]
    p.legF = [0.4, 0.28]
    p.legB = [-0.45, -0.3]
    p.bob = Math.sin(t * 18) * 2
  } else if (state === 'solar') {
    p.lean = -0.04
    p.armF = [1.45, 2.35]
    p.armB = [1.2, 2.5]
    p.legF = [0.28, 0.14]
    p.legB = [-0.36, -0.2]
  } else if (state === 'spirit') {
    p.lean = -0.03
    p.armF = [2.65, 2.75]
    p.armB = [-2.65, -2.75]
    p.legF = [0.32, 0.2]
    p.legB = [-0.4, -0.26]
    p.bob = Math.sin(t * 5) * 2
  } else if (state === 'dragon') {
    p.lean = 0.26
    p.armF = [1.52, 1.58]
    p.armB = [-0.95, -1.3]
    p.legF = [0.62, 0.72]
    p.legB = [-0.62, -0.5]
  } else if (state === 'victory') {
    p.armF = [2.75, 2.85]
    p.armB = [-2.7, -2.8]
    p.legF = [0.2, 0.08]
    p.legB = [-0.24, -0.12]
    p.bob = Math.sin(t * 3.2) * 2
  } else if (state === 'ko') {
    p.lean = 0
    p.armF = [0.4, 0.8]
    p.armB = [-0.6, -0.9]
    p.legF = [0.3, 0.5]
    p.legB = [-0.3, -0.5]
  }
  return p
}

export function drawFighter(ctx, f, t, opts = {}) {
  const form = FORMS[f.form || 0]
  const p = pal(f)
  const scale = f.scale || 1
  const facing = f.facing || 1
  const pose = getPose(f, form, t)
  const isPlayer = f.kind === 'player'

  // Ground shadow
  if (!opts.noShadow) {
    const lift = clamp((GROUND - f.y) / 480, 0, 1)
    const alpha = 0.4 * (1 - lift * 0.72)
    const rx = 50 * scale * (1 - lift * 0.2)
    const shine = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, GROUND + 4, 2, f.x, GROUND + 4, rx)
    shine.addColorStop(0, `rgba(2,3,10,${alpha})`)
    shine.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(3,4,12,${alpha * 0.55})`)
    shine.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3,4,12,0)')
    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(f.x, GROUND + 3)
    ctx.scale(1, 0.23)
    ctx.fillStyle = shine
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, rx, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()
  }

  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(f.x, f.y)
  if (f.state === 'ko' && (f.koT || 0) > 0.12) {
    const fall = clamp((f.koT - 0.12) * 3.4, 0, 1)
    ctx.rotate(-facing * fall * 1.42)
    ctx.translate(0, -8 * fall)
  }
  ctx.scale(facing * scale, scale)
  if (opts.alpha !== undefined) ctx.globalAlpha = opts.alpha
  if (opts.tint) {
    ctx.shadowColor = opts.tint
    ctx.shadowBlur = 22
  }
  if (f.hitFlash > 0.03) ctx.filter = 'brightness(2.1) saturate(0.55)'
  else if (isPlayer && f.formFx > 0) ctx.filter = 'brightness(1.2)'
  if (f.formFx > 0) ctx.filter = `brightness(${1.2 + f.formFx}) drop-shadow(0 0 ${18 * f.formFx}px ${form.aura2})`

  drawAura(ctx, f, p, form, t, opts)
  drawBackExtras(ctx, f, p, pose, t)
  drawBody(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t, opts)
  drawFrontExtras(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t, opts)
  drawChargeOrb(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t)

  ctx.filter = 'none'
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawAura(ctx, f, p, form, t, opts) {
  const isPlayer = f.kind === 'player'
  const level = isPlayer ? f.form || 0 : (f.enraged ? 4 : 2)
  const active = f.state === 'charge' || f.state === 'transform' || f.state === 'spirit' || f.formFx > 0
  if (level <= 0 && !active) return
  const color = p.aura
  const color2 = p.aura2
  const baseAlpha = isPlayer ? (level === 0 ? 0.18 : form.auraAlpha) : (f.enraged ? 0.7 : 0.42)
  const boost = f.state === 'charge' ? 1.25 : f.state === 'transform' ? 1.55 : f.formFx > 0 ? 1.35 : 1
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -108, 12, 0, -108, 128 * boost)
  glow.addColorStop(0, hexA(color, 0.34 * baseAlpha))
  glow.addColorStop(0.45, hexA(color, 0.16 * baseAlpha))
  glow.addColorStop(1, hexA(color, 0))
  ctx.fillStyle = glow
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -108, 76 * boost, 142 * boost, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()

  const n = isPlayer ? 12 + level * 2 : 10
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const side = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1
    const x = (i - n / 2) * 8 + Math.sin(t * 5 + i * 2.1) * 5
    const h = (70 + (i % 4) * 24 + Math.sin(t * 9 + i * 1.7) * 20 + level * 9) * boost
    const w = 7 + (i % 3) * 4
    const hue = i % 3 === 0 ? color2 : color
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, -10, x, -h - 40)
    g.addColorStop(0, hexA(hue, 0))
    g.addColorStop(0.3, hexA(hue, 0.22 * baseAlpha))
    g.addColorStop(0.75, hexA(hue, 0.34 * baseAlpha))
    g.addColorStop(1, hexA(hue, 0))
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x - w, 0)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - w * 0.55, -h * 0.55, x - w * 0.16, -h)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.6, -h * 0.5, x + w, 0)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    if (side > 0 && i % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(color2, 0.10 * baseAlpha)
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4
      ctx.stroke()
    }
  }

  if (isPlayer && form.lightning) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(color2, 0.7)
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6
    ctx.shadowColor = color2
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const sx = Math.sin(t * 7 + i * 4) * 58
      const sy = -40 - ((i * 43 + t * 60) % 150)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy)
      for (let j = 1; j <= 4; j++) {
        ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.sin(t * 30 + i * 9 + j) * 16, sy + j * 9)
      }
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  }
  if (isPlayer && level >= 7) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#ffffff', 0.24 + Math.sin(t * 4) * 0.06)
    ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, -100 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 6, 48, 104, Math.sin(t * 1.4) * 0.12, 0, TAU)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawBackExtras(ctx, f, p, pose, t) {
  const v = p.v
  if (v === 'frieza') {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline
    ctx.lineWidth = 15
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-8, -78); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-70, -70, -82, -14, -48, 4); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.skin; ctx.lineWidth = 10
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-8, -78); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-70, -70, -82, -14, -48, 4); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.armor; ctx.lineWidth = 5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-40, -6); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-48, 4, -54, 6, -60, 2); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.restore()
  }
  if (v === 'beerus') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 13; ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-10, -80); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-76, -70, -80, -18, -52, 0); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.skin; ctx.lineWidth = 8
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-10, -80); ctx.bezierCurveTo(-76, -70, -80, -18, -52, 0); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.restore()
  }
  if (v === 'cell') {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.outline
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -64); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-82, -108, -96, -46)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-70, -42, -64, 8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-38, -24, -10, -30)
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#234b2a'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-12, -64); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-76, -102, -88, -48)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-64, -44, -58, 2); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-36, -24, -12, -32)
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#132d18'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-56, -68, 6, 0, TAU); ctx.arc(-72, -48, 4, 0, TAU); ctx.arc(-48, -36, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()
  }
  if (v === 'broly') {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2a1e'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-30, -64); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-54, -40, -42, -8)
    ctx.lineTo(-20, -14); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, -40, -16, -56)
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()
  }
}

function drawFrontExtras(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t, opts) {
  const v = p.v
  if (v === 'buu') {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(2, -181); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(10 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 4, -212, 26, -214); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.skin; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(2, -181); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(10 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 4, -212, 26, -214); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.outline; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(27, -214, 6.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(27, -214, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.restore()
  }
  if (f.tinted && opts.alpha) {
    ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha *= 0.25
    ctx.restore()
  }
}

function drawChargeOrb(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t) {
  const handX = 48
  const handY = -128
  if (f.state === 'beamCharge') {
    const r = 9 + Math.min(1, (f.beamHold || 0) / 1.15) * 18
    drawOrb(ctx, handX, handY, r, p.aura, p.aura2)
  }
  if (f.state === 'skill' && f.skillId === 'spirit' && (f.spiritCharge || 0) > 0) {
    const r = 18 + (f.spiritCharge || 0) * 48
    drawOrb(ctx, 0, -232, r, '#8fe9ff', '#ffffff')
    ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,230,255,.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(0, -232, r + 12 + i * 8, r * 0.35 + 8, t * (0.7 + i * 0.2) + i, 0, TAU)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }
  if (f.kind === 'enemy' && f.state === 'special' && f.special && (f.special.type === 'beam' || f.special.type === 'orb')) {
    const r = 8 + Math.min(1, (f.specialT || 0) / 1.1) * 20
    drawOrb(ctx, 52, -132, r, p.aura, p.aura2)
  }
}

function drawOrb(ctx, x, y, r, c1, c2) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 1, x, y, r * 2.6)
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff')
  g.addColorStop(0.18, c2)
  g.addColorStop(0.5, hexA(c1, 0.7))
  g.addColorStop(1, hexA(c1, 0))
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 2.6, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 0.55, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(c2, 0.8); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawBody(ctx, f, p, pose, form, t, opts) {
  const v = p.v
  const big = v === 'broly' ? 1.18 : v === 'jiren' ? 1.08 : 1
  const hipY = pose.hipY

  // ---- back leg
  const legW = (v === 'broly' ? 17 : v === 'buu' ? 16 : 14)
  const backLegColor = v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? p.pants2 : p.skin2
  const bl = limb(ctx, -5, hipY, pose.legB[0], pose.legB[1], 43, 43, legW + 2, legW, backLegColor, p.outline,
    v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? p.boot : v === 'buu' ? p.pants2 : null,
    v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? 7 : 0)
  if (v === 'goku' || v === 'black') foot(ctx, bl.fx, bl.fy - 1, 1, p.boot, p.boot2, p.outline)
  else if (v === 'buu') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bl.fx, bl.fy - 1, 7.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
  } else if (v === 'frieza') foot(ctx, bl.fx, bl.fy - 1, 1, p.armor, p.accent, p.outline)

  // ---- upper body transform
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(0, hipY)
  ctx.rotate(pose.lean)
  ctx.translate(0, pose.bob)

  // back arm
  const shoulderY = -52
  drawArm(ctx, -7, shoulderY, pose.armB[0], pose.armB[1], p, v, false, big)
  // torso
  drawTorso(ctx, f, p, v, form, t, opts)
  // head
  drawHead(ctx, f, p, v, form, t)
  // front arm
  drawArm(ctx, 5, shoulderY - 2, pose.armF[0], pose.armF[1], p, v, true, big)

  ctx.restore()

  // ---- front leg (drawn after torso so it overlays the hip)
  const frontLegColor = v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? p.pants : p.skin
  const fl = limb(ctx, 4, hipY, pose.legF[0], pose.legF[1], 43, 43, legW + 2, legW, frontLegColor, p.outline,
    v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? p.boot : v === 'buu' ? p.pants2 : null,
    v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? 7 : 0)
  if (v === 'goku' || v === 'black') foot(ctx, fl.fx, fl.fy - 1, 1, p.boot, p.boot2, p.outline)
  else if (v === 'buu') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fl.fx, fl.fy - 1, 7.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
  } else if (v === 'frieza') foot(ctx, fl.fx, fl.fy - 1, 1, p.armor, p.accent, p.outline)
  else if (v === 'broly') foot(ctx, fl.fx, fl.fy - 1, 1, p.boot, p.boot2, p.outline, true)
}

function drawArm(ctx, sx, sy, a1, a2, p, v, front, big) {
  const upper = big ? 37 : 33
  const fore = big ? 36 : 31
  const w1 = (front ? 11 : 9.5) * (big ? 1.2 : 1)
  const w2 = (front ? 9.5 : 8) * (big ? 1.2 : 1)
  let color = p.skin
  let cap = null
  if (v === 'goku') cap = p.wrist
  if (v === 'black') { color = p.gi; cap = p.wrist }
  if (v === 'frieza') { color = p.armor; cap = p.accent }
  if (v === 'cell') color = front ? p.skin : p.skin2
  if (v === 'buu') color = p.skin
  if (v === 'broly') { color = p.skin; cap = p.wrist }
  if (v === 'beerus') { color = p.skin; cap = p.accent }
  if (v === 'jiren') { color = p.skin; cap = p.wrist }
  const l = limb(ctx, sx, sy, a1, a2, upper, fore, w1, w2, color, p.outline, cap, v === 'goku' ? 6 : 7)
  const handColor = v === 'frieza' ? p.armor : v === 'cell' ? p.skin : p.skin
  hand(ctx, l.fx, l.fy, big ? 6.5 : 5.5, handColor, p.outline)
  if (v === 'jiren') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(l.kx, l.ky); ctx.lineTo(l.fx, l.fy); ctx.stroke()
  }
  return l
}

function drawTorso(ctx, f, p, v, form, t, opts) {
  const outline = p.outline
  // Base torso silhouette
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-17, 4)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-23, -28, -22, -48)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-22, -58, -16, -61)
  ctx.lineTo(16, -61)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(23, -58, 22, -47)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(22, -26, 15, 4)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fillStyle = v === 'goku' || v === 'black' ? p.gi : p.skin
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = outline; ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.stroke()

  if (v === 'goku' || v === 'black') {
    // blue undershirt
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-16, -61); ctx.lineTo(-7, -61); ctx.lineTo(0, -43); ctx.lineTo(-12, -38); ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.under; ctx.fill()
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(16, -61); ctx.lineTo(7, -61); ctx.lineTo(0, -43); ctx.lineTo(12, -38); ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fillStyle = hexA(p.under, 0.92); ctx.fill()
    // gi shading
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(6, -59); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, -40, 14, 3); ctx.lineTo(6, 3)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(13, -35, 1, -52); ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fillStyle = hexA(p.gi2, 0.55); ctx.fill()
    // belt
    ctx.fillStyle = p.belt
    ctx.fillRect(-17, -8, 33, 9)
    ctx.fillStyle = hexA('#000000', 0.25)
    ctx.fillRect(-17, 0, 33, 2)
    // knot
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-10, -4, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = p.belt; ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#000000', 0.25); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke()
    // chest symbol
    if (v === 'goku') {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7
      ctx.fillStyle = '#173b93'
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif'
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'
      ctx.fillText('悟', 12, -35)
      ctx.restore()
    }
    // folds
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#ffffff', 0.22); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-13, -36); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8, -22, -11, -9); ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'frieza') {
    // white chest armour
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-17, -58)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4, -45, 0, -29)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(5, -45, 17, -58)
    ctx.lineTo(18, -31)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(8, -20, 0, -16)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-9, -20, -18, -32)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.armor; ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = p.accent
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-13, -49, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(13, -49, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(p.accent, 0.6); ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-8, -24); ctx.lineTo(8, -24); ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'cell') {
    // dark chest plates
    ctx.fillStyle = p.armor
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, -56); ctx.lineTo(-3, -38); ctx.lineTo(-8, -19); ctx.lineTo(-19, -28); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(18, -56); ctx.lineTo(3, -38); ctx.lineTo(8, -19); ctx.lineTo(19, -28); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1411'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-7, -44); ctx.lineTo(7, -44); ctx.lineTo(10, -12); ctx.lineTo(-10, -12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    // spots
    ctx.fillStyle = '#19301d'
    for (const [x, y, r] of [[-12, -51, 4], [13, -31, 3], [-10, -12, 3], [7, -54, 2.5]]) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill()
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14, -24); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -17, 14, -24); ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'buu') {
    // dark vest
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b1a34'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, -58); ctx.lineTo(0, -43); ctx.lineTo(18, -58); ctx.lineTo(15, -8); ctx.lineTo(-15, -8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#ff9ad9', 0.5); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-11, -50); ctx.lineTo(-7, -14); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(11, -50); ctx.lineTo(7, -14); ctx.stroke()
    // baggy pants waist
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ebdc'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, 2); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-24, -6, -15, -9); ctx.lineTo(15, -9); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(24, -6, 18, 2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'broly') {
    // bare muscular chest
    ctx.fillStyle = p.skin2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-15, -48); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -38, 15, -48); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(17, -22, 0, -15); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-17, -22, -15, -48); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#000000', 0.25); ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -46); ctx.lineTo(0, -18); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-16, -30); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -23, 16, -30); ctx.stroke()
    // pelt
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4b3826'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-22, -4); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-28, 8, -12, 10); ctx.lineTo(22, 8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(28, -3, 18, -8); ctx.lineTo(-18, -8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a1f15'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#7b6043'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    for (let i = -15; i < 18; i += 7) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i, -5); ctx.lineTo(i + 2, 7); ctx.stroke() }
    // scar
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a4564b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(14, -50); ctx.lineTo(17, -38); ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'beerus') {
    // dark chest + gold collar
    ctx.fillStyle = p.suit || '#241b31'
    ctx.fillRect(-17, -58, 34, 56)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e7c35c'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, -61); ctx.lineTo(18, -61); ctx.lineTo(14, -52); ctx.lineTo(-14, -52); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2b4d'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -52); ctx.lineTo(6, -42); ctx.lineTo(0, -12); ctx.lineTo(-6, -42); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = hexA('#c86bff', 0.5); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12, -44); ctx.lineTo(-12, -8); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(12, -44); ctx.lineTo(12, -8); ctx.stroke()
  } else if (v === 'jiren') {
    // uniform
    ctx.fillStyle = p.gi
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, -60); ctx.lineTo(0, -46); ctx.lineTo(18, -60); ctx.lineTo(16, 3); ctx.lineTo(-16, 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-15, -56); ctx.lineTo(-5, -42); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(15, -56); ctx.lineTo(5, -42); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9dde2'; ctx.lineWidth = 2
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-10, -30); ctx.lineTo(-7, 2); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(10, -30); ctx.lineTo(7, 2); ctx.stroke()
    // muscular arms are skin; chest exposed
    ctx.fillStyle = p.skin
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-10, -48); ctx.lineTo(0, -38); ctx.lineTo(10, -48); ctx.lineTo(8, -32); ctx.lineTo(-8, -32); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
  }
}

function drawHead(ctx, f, p, v, form, t) {
  const hx = 4
  const hy = -84
  if (v === 'frieza') return drawFriezaHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  if (v === 'cell') return drawCellHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  if (v === 'buu') return drawBuuHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  if (v === 'beerus') return drawBeerusHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  if (v === 'jiren') return drawJirenHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  if (v === 'broly') return drawBrolyHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t)
  drawGokuHead(ctx, f, p, v, form, hx, hy, t)
}

function drawGokuHead(ctx, f, p, v, form, hx, hy, t) {
  // neck
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin
  ctx.fillRect(hx - 7, hy + 10, 14, 14)
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 3
  ctx.strokeRect(hx - 7, hy + 10, 14, 14)
  // hair behind
  drawHair(ctx, f, p, v, form, hx, hy, t, true)
  // head
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.ellipse(hx, hy, 18.5, 20, 0, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke()
  // jaw
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(hx - 12, hy + 8)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 2, hy + 21, hx + 12, hy + 9)
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(p.skin2, 0.55); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke()
  // ear
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx - 15, hy + 2, 4.4, 6, -0.25, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin2; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke()
  // eye
  ctx.save()
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.ellipse(hx + 8.5, hy - 1.5, 5.2, 4.2, -0.1, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.eyeWhite; ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx + 9.6, hy - 1, 2.8, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = p.eye; ctx.fill()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx + 10.2, hy - 2, 1, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fill()
  // brow
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.hair; ctx.lineWidth = 2.8; ctx.lineCap = 'round'
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 3, hy - 7); ctx.lineTo(hx + 14, hy - 5.5); ctx.stroke()
  // nose + mouth
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(p.skin2, 0.85); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 16, hy + 1); ctx.lineTo(hx + 12, hy + 4); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 5, hy + 12); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 10, hy + 14, hx + 15, hy + 11); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.restore()
  // hair front
  drawHair(ctx, f, p, v, form, hx, hy, t, false)
}

const HAIR = {
  base: [[-19, 3], [-25, -5], [-21, -10], [-29, -17], [-17, -15], [-19, -26], [-8, -21], [-7, -33], [2, -23], [9, -31], [12, -20], [22, -23], [18, -12], [27, -8], [18, -3], [20, 7], [11, 3], [5, 9], [-3, 4], [-10, 8]],
  ssj: [[-23, 5], [-31, -7], [-24, -11], [-36, -24], [-21, -20], [-29, -38], [-13, -28], [-17, -50], [-4, -33], [0, -53], [9, -33], [15, -50], [19, -27], [31, -37], [28, -17], [38, -22], [33, -5], [42, 3], [28, 3], [22, 12], [12, 4], [4, 11], [-7, 10]],
  ssj2: [[-24, 5], [-34, -8], [-25, -12], [-38, -27], [-22, -22], [-31, -43], [-14, -31], [-19, -56], [-5, -36], [-1, -60], [8, -36], [15, -55], [19, -29], [33, -41], [30, -19], [41, -24], [35, -5], [45, 5], [30, 4], [24, 14], [13, 5], [4, 12], [-8, 11]],
  god: [[-21, 4], [-28, -6], [-22, -11], [-32, -21], [-18, -18], [-24, -33], [-10, -25], [-10, -41], [0, -28], [7, -42], [12, -26], [24, -32], [20, -14], [33, -18], [28, -2], [38, 4], [25, 3], [19, 11], [9, 4], [2, 10], [-8, 9]],
  blue: [[-22, 5], [-30, -6], [-23, -11], [-35, -23], [-20, -19], [-27, -37], [-12, -27], [-15, -47], [-3, -31], [1, -50], [10, -31], [16, -47], [20, -26], [31, -35], [28, -16], [38, -21], [32, -4], [41, 4], [27, 4], [21, 12], [11, 4], [3, 11], [-7, 10]],
  ui: [[-22, 5], [-30, -6], [-23, -11], [-34, -22], [-20, -19], [-27, -36], [-12, -26], [-14, -45], [-3, -30], [1, -48], [10, -30], [16, -45], [20, -25], [30, -33], [27, -15], [37, -20], [31, -4], [39, 4], [26, 4], [20, 11], [10, 4], [3, 10], [-7, 9]]
}

function drawHair(ctx, f, p, v, form, hx, hy, t, back) {
  const level = f.form || 0
  let set = HAIR.base
  if (v === 'black') set = HAIR.base
  else if (level === 1) set = HAIR.ssj
  else if (level === 2) set = HAIR.ssj2
  else if (level === 3) set = HAIR.ssj2
  else if (level === 4) set = HAIR.god
  else if (level === 5 || level === 6) set = HAIR.blue
  else if (level >= 7) set = HAIR.ui
  if (v === 'broly') set = HAIR.ssj2
  const color = p.hair
  const color2 = p.hair2
  ctx.save()
  if (back) {
    if (level === 3 && v !== 'broly') {
      // Super Saiyan 3 long mane
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline
      ctx.lineWidth = 3
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(hx - 16, hy - 8)
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx - 44, hy + 18, hx - 42, hy + 76, hx - 24, hy + 108)
      ctx.lineTo(hx - 8, hy + 96)
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 1, hy + 116)
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 10, hy + 94)
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 20, hy + 104)
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx + 18, hy + 52, hx + 10, hy + 12, hx + 8, hy - 10)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
      ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(color2, 0.6); ctx.lineWidth = 2
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + i * 10, hy + 12); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + i * 18, hy + 54, hx + i * 15, hy + 92); ctx.stroke()
      }
    } else if (v === 'broly') {
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline
      ctx.lineWidth = 3
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(hx - 3, hy - 14, 44, 38, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
    } else {
      // back volume
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(hx - 5, hy - 5, 20, 22, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
    }
    ctx.restore()
    return
  }
  // spiky silhouette
  ctx.beginPath()
  set.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
    const px = hx + x * (v === 'broly' ? 1.5 : 1)
    const py = hy + y * (v === 'broly' ? 1.45 : 1)
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py)
    else ctx.lineTo(px, py)
  })
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fillStyle = color
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.8
  ctx.stroke()
  // hair shine / strands
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(color2, 0.75)
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx - 10, hy - 18); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 4, hy - 30, hx + 2, hy - 24); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 15); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 12, hy - 27, hx + 18, hy - 20); ctx.stroke()
  // front bangs
  ctx.fillStyle = color
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline
  ctx.lineWidth = 2
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(hx - 4, hy - 16)
  ctx.lineTo(hx + 7, hy - 33)
  ctx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy - 13)
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(hx + 9, hy - 17)
  ctx.lineTo(hx + 20, hy - 28)
  ctx.lineTo(hx + 18, hy - 8)
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
  if (level >= 7) {
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffffff'
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawFriezaHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t) {
  // neck
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin
  ctx.fillRect(hx - 6, hy + 10, 12, 14)
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeRect(hx - 6, hy + 10, 12, 14)
  // purple dome
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx - 3, hy - 6, 20, 20, 0, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke()
  // white face
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx + 7, hy + 2, 13, 15, -0.1, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.armor; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke()
  // horns
  ctx.fillStyle = p.armor
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx - 12, hy - 20); ctx.lineTo(hx - 2, hy - 14); ctx.lineTo(hx - 14, hy - 31); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 5, hy - 20); ctx.lineTo(hx + 13, hy - 14); ctx.lineTo(hx + 10, hy - 30); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
  // eye
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx + 11, hy - 1, 5, 3.6, -0.1, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx + 12, hy - 1, 2.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = p.eye; ctx.fill()
  // mouth
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 1.7
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 5, hy + 11); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 10, hy + 13, hx + 15, hy + 10); ctx.stroke()
  // cheek line
  ctx.strokeStyle = hexA(p.skin2, 0.7); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx - 2, hy + 5); ctx.lineTo(hx + 3, hy + 10); ctx.stroke()
}

function drawCellHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t) {
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin
  ctx.fillRect(hx - 6, hy + 8, 12, 16)
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeRect(hx - 6, hy + 8, 12, 16)
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx + 2, hy, 19, 20, 0, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke()
  // crown horns
  ctx.fillStyle = p.armor

function drawBrolyHead(ctx, p, hx, hy, t) {

  drawHair(ctx, { form: 2, kind: 'enemy' }, p, 'broly', FORMS[2], hx, hy, t, true)
  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin
  ctx.fillRect(hx - 7, hy + 9, 14, 15)

  ctx.fillStyle = p.skin; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke()
  // eyes
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx + 10, hy - 2, 6, 4.6, -0.1, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx + 11, hy - 1, 2.8, 0, TAU); ctx.fillStyle = p.eye; ctx.fill()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 2, hy - 8); ctx.lineTo(hx + 16, hy - 6); ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.stroke()
  // mouth / scar
  ctx.strokeStyle = p.outline; ctx.lineWidth = 2
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 4, hy + 11); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 10, hy + 14, hx + 16, hy + 9); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#a4564b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx + 17, hy - 8); ctx.lineTo(hx + 15, hy + 5); ctx.stroke()
  // front hair
  drawHair(ctx, { form: 2, kind: 'enemy' }, p, 'broly', FORMS[2], hx, hy, t, false)
}

function hexA(hex, alpha) {
  if (!hex) return `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`
  if (hex.startsWith('rgba') || hex.startsWith('rgb')) return hex
  let h = hex.replace('#', '')
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split('').map(c => c + c).join('')
  const n = parseInt(h, 16)
  const r = (n >> 16) & 255
  const g = (n >> 8) & 255
  const b = n & 255
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`
}
